description: This PHP source file defines the AccessEmployeeController class, which manages access control and component rendering for employee access within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. It handles requests, enforces admin privileges, and initializes Vue components with configuration data.

classes.name: AccessEmployeeController
classes.description: Controller class for managing employee access permissions, rendering Vue components, and enforcing admin privileges within the maintenance plugin.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes and sets the Vue component with instance-specific configuration before rendering.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming requests, verifies admin privileges, and forwards or delegates as necessary.
